parameters.description: Provider format: anthropic, openai, openai-responses, ollama or codex-cli. codex-cli uses the official Codex CLI for ChatGPT OAuth or the Z.AI Coding Plan.

parameters.name: base_url
parameters.description: Provider API base URL. For codex-cli, leave empty for ChatGPT OAuth or use https://api.z.ai/api/v1 for the GLM Coding Plan.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: HTTP provider outbound proxy. codex-cli does not support this field; leave empty.

parameters.name: context_window_k
parameters.description:
ContextWindowK is the model's context window in K tokens, used to size
compaction thresholds. 0 = use a 200K default; capped at 1000 (1M).

parameters.name: thinking_type
parameters.description:
ThinkingType independently controls thinking.type: empty omits it (default);
"disabled" explicitly disables it and "enabled" enables it, independently of ReasoningEffort.

parameters.name: reasoning_effort
parameters.description:
ReasoningEffort independently controls reasoning intensity: empty omits it (default);
"low"/"medium"/"high"/"xhigh"/"max" select intensity. See agent.Config.NewProvider.

parameters.name: priority
parameters.description:
Priority orders the failover chain: higher goes first. The ACTIVE profile
(IsDefault) always heads the chain regardless of this value.

parameters.name: pool_exclude
parameters.description:
PoolExclude=true keeps this profile out of the failover chain — it stays
usable when an agent/task binds it explicitly, it just never gets picked up
as a fallback target.

parameters.name: streaming
parameters.description: Use provider streaming. codex-cli buffers and validates each structured completion before emitting text and tool events.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Output-token limit for HTTP providers. For codex-cli this is an advisory model instruction, not an API-enforced cap.

parameters.name: max_tokens_field
parameters.description:
MaxTokensField picks the request key carrying MaxTokens, for format
"openai" only: "" = max_tokens (default); "max_completion_tokens" = the
newer key, which OpenAI's reasoning models require and whose budget covers
reasoning tokens plus visible output. Ignored by anthropic and
openai-responses, which name the field themselves.

parameters.name: session_header_key
parameters.description:
SessionHeaderKey, when non-empty, names a custom HTTP header sent on every
request built from this profile; its value is the current run's session id
(chat conversation / worker intent). For gateways that key prompt caching
or sticky routing off a session-id header. "" = not sent. Maps to
agent.Config.SessionHeaderKey.

parameters.name: retry
parameters.description:
Retry overrides this profile's share of the retry ladder. Zero value =
inherit the global policy (LLMRetryPolicy), so an untouched profile behaves
exactly as before. See RetryOverride.

parameters.name: stream

parameters.name: breaker

Hard failures such as insufficient balance/invalid keys still trip immediately. IntervalMS is fixed cooldown; 0 uses 1/5/30min tiers.
